decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established dumper range in a growing market, it likely has low carrying cost and still offers option value because one year is too early to judge its full demand.

This articulated construction dumper fits the core business and service system, so management would usually keep it while uncertainty resolves rather than abandon a plausible adjacent product after only a short market test.

Because the underground mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the established offer and likely costlier to support, its exit risk is clearly higher, but without clear evidence of failure the option to learn from this niche market still justifies keeping it for now.

A compact telescopic loader line with several models signals a broader strategic commitment in the firm’s core domain, and shared engineering, parts and service capabilities make continued market presence the more likely choice.
